get.description: Retrieve approved content for a specified account and stream

parameters.name: tweet_mode
parameters.description: This will expose the latest Tweet format from Twitter where the payload contains all information required to render Tweets that contain more than 140 characters.

get.summary: Specify amount of content to pull
get.description: Includes a query parameter to return a specific number of entities

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of status entities to return. **Maximum:** `200` **Minimum:** `1`

get.description: Includes only those status entities approved after supplied status entity_id biasing towards real-time

parameters.name: since_id
parameters.description: Includes only those status entities approved after supplied status entity_id biasing towards real-time. (e.g. “entity_id” = 255682528302747648)"

get.description: Includes only those status entities approved after supplied status entity_id without skipping over status entities
Includes only those status entities approved before supplied status `entity_id`

parameters.name: start_id
parameters.description: Includes only those status entities approved before supplied status entity_id. This parameter is commonly used to implement ‘More’ functionality on a stream of content, wherein an end user sees a stream of content, then clicks on a ‘More’ link to display the next N entities. By supplying the entity_id of the last viewed entity, you may request the set of entities that came before it in the stream.

get.description: Enables JSONP support. Wraps JSON response with a JavaScript function of given name. (e.g. ?callback=myFunction)
Includes only those status entities approved before supplied status `entity_id`

parameters.name: geo_hint
parameters.description: When possible, geo_hint adds inferred status entity location from the authoring user’s profile information. The data is added the to geo_hint property of a Twitter status entity. (e.g. 1)

get.summary: Enable product hinting for each entity
get.description: Enable product hinting by specified account and stream

parameters.name: page_links
parameters.description: This parameter is used for Product Linking and must be set to true to surface up any product data that is linked to the entity. The absence of the parameter or it being set to false will assume that you are not requesting product linked data. If set to true, the data is added the to massrel/page_links property of an entity. (e.g. 1)

get.description: Includes the status entity that a status entity replied to. The status entity is added to the in_reply_to property of a status entity

parameters.name: replies
parameters.description: Includes the status entity that a status entity replied to. The status entity is added to the in_reply_to property of a status entity. (e.g. 1)

get.summary: Specify Social Network to gather entities
get.description: Includes entities from a specified social network only

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: Includes entities from a specified social network only. **Possible Values:** `facebook`, `instagram`, `google_plus`, and `rss`. **Notes:** Must be a single value (`network=facebook`). Multiple values are not supported.
